sections.title: Buffer Accumulation
sections.text_preview: The Buffer Accumulator accepts incoming buffers and queues them for later processing. This is useful when the data arrival rate may temporarily exceed the processing rate, or to pause buffer processin

sections.title: Buffer Replication
sections.text_preview: The Buffer Repeater takes an incoming buffer and replicates it to multiple output ports. This is useful when the same data needs to be consumed by multiple downstream components simultaneously.
